description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'ImmutableConnectionFailure' that implements the 'ConnectionFailure' interface. It encapsulates details about a connection failure event, including the cause, description, timestamp, and provides methods to retrieve failure details and override standard Object methods.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionFailure
classes.description: An immutable representation of a connection failure, storing cause, description, timestamp, and providing failure message details.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing origin, cause, description, and capturing current time.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns a Status.Failure object encapsulating the cause.

methods.name: getFailureDescription
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive description string of the failure, including cause, description, and timestamp.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on cause, description, and time fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on cause, description, and time.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object including cause, description, and time.
